content.title: Kings Streaming
content.text: Here’s all the info to watch and stream Domantas Sabonis, Keegan Murray and the Sacramento Kings: How do I stream the Sacramento Kings online? If you live in the Kings team territory and have a provider that includes NBC Sports California, you can stream the Kings on the NBC Sports app or right here. Can I stream the Kings if I do not have cable? If you do not have cable, NBC Sports California is included on DirecTV Stream, FuboTV, Hulu, Peacock and YouTube TV. What if the stream is not working? If you are experiencing technical issues with the stream, please visit help.nbc.com, where you can submit a question, find additional tutorials and FAQs, and learn more about streaming all of the content from NBC’s family of networks. Can I stream the Kings in the NBC Sports Bay Area & CA app? Authenticated live streaming for Kings’ games on NBC Sports California is exclusively on the NBC Sports app. The NBC Sports Bay Area & CA app will link to the NBC Sports app to make it easy to find. Keep checking the NBC Sports Bay Area & CA app for all the latest news, highlights, and analysis. When do the Kings play? You can find the Sacramento Kings’ full schedule here. Stay with NBC Sports California and follow us on Twitter and Instagram for all of your Kings coverage throughout the season.
